purpose: HIGH-VALUE permanent combat BiS / near-BiS region chains for MELEE and RANGED only. Complements progression-enrichment-regional-combat-2026-07-25 (+ pass-2/pass-3). Does not re-emit existing regional-combat-unlocks ids (e.g. cross-region:igneous-zuk-capes, broken-home:asylum-surgeons-ring).

policy.region_rule: required_regions means every listed region contributes a mandatory base-game acquisition step for a full self-source chain. region_hints means the chain touches those regions but may have tradeable intermediates or alternate supply. Use all_required when multi-region acquisition is hard; acquisition_region when a single region owns the drop/craft hub; support for soft adjacency.
policy.league_rule: Quest auto-completion and League passives are overlays. Do not erase geography until Jagex replaces it. Senntisten / EGW / City of Um / Fort Forinthry stay on the Misthalin working taxonomy unless Equilibrium reassigns them.
policy.style_scope: MELEE and RANGED permanent gear chains only. Magic-only BiS (seismic, praesul wand, tectonic craft as primary product) is out of scope except where it is a required material for melee/ranged trim (praesulic essence from Torva).
policy.duplicate_rule: Do not re-emit ids already in data/research/regional-combat-unlocks.json.

equipment_additions.name: Trimmed / custom-fit trimmed masterwork melee armour

Morytania: full malevolent set equivalent breaks down into malevolent essence — Malevolent energy/armour from Barrows: Rise of the Six
